string.text: Log:\nComms check. One, two. If you read this, answer. If you don't - the battery again.
Log:\nPatrol 3. Route: checkpoint - bridge - grain elevator. Contact: two civilians, withdrew towards the village. No fire opened.
Incoming:\nPerimeter, all units. No trespasser leaves without a warning. Stalkers with loot - detain, hand loot to the duty officer. Signed for.
Log:\n"Signed for" again. And then the duty officer has a new watch and imported canned meat. Sure.
Log:\nShots by the embankment last night. In the morning only casings and blood. No body. The sergeant major said not to log it.
Incoming:\nAll posts. Emission expected within 24 hours. Personnel to shelters on command. Nobody runs without the command; whoever does gets disciplined.
Log:\nStalkers aren't people, they're rats with rifles. Today one slipped the lieutenant a "jellyfish" to get through. The lieutenant took it.
Log:\n112 days till discharge. Third week without radio batteries. Comms work every other time.
Incoming:\nGroup "Falcon" missed the 06:00 check-in. Last position - Agroprom, sewer collector. No search until further orders.
Log:\nNo search... Seryoga Kovalyov is out there. We were together since training.
Log:\nDuty asked for ammo for canned food again. The captain does the trading himself, we don't see a single tin.
Incoming:\nHelicopter to Yantar cancelled. Tell the scientists to wait for the convoy. Do not give convoy dates.
Incoming:\nPost, report status.
Outgoing:\nQuiet. Dogs howling past the embankment, not coming near the post.
Incoming:\nSearchlight on, don't fire at the dogs. No spare ammo.
Outgoing:\nRoger. Only they've stopped howling.
Log:\nPassword for the day: "Barrier" - reply "Forty-two". Change at 00:00. Tell nobody. (Writing it down because I'll forget again.)
Log:\nDon't tell Mum where I'm serving. I'll say a training camp near Zhytomyr. She won't believe it anyway.
Incoming:\nConvoy is out. Two trucks, one APC escort. Crossing the bridge at 14:00.
Outgoing:\nCopy. Bridge is clear, the anomaly by the pillar is where it was.
Incoming:\nAnd the "springboard" at the approach?
Outgoing:\nShifted about three metres. Marked it with stakes. Warn the drivers.
Incoming:\nWill do. Guard the stakes, stalkers steal them.
Log:\nAsked the captain why we're here. He said: "So nobody comes out of there." I asked - and if someone goes in? "Let them."
Log:\nFound a notebook of Cordon anomalies on a detainee. Better than our map. Handed it in. Copied it first.
Incoming:\nVanyok, you asleep?
Outgoing:\nNobody sleeps on post. What do you want?
Incoming:\nSaw stalkers wearing stones on their belts. They say it helps against bullets.
Outgoing:\nA vest helps against bullets. Stones give you radiation sickness. Don't be stupid.
Incoming:\nFine. But I've already got one.
Incoming:\nUnit order. Personnel are forbidden from trading with factions or loners. Violators face court-martial.
Log:\nThe warrant officer sells our ammo to stalkers, then we confiscate the same ammo from them. The ammo cycle of nature.
Incoming:\nGroup, report on Agroprom.
Outgoing:\nReached the institute. Three bandits, pulled back without a fight. No sign of "Falcon".
Incoming:\nDo not go down into the collector.
Outgoing:\nWe're already down. There are tracks. Not human.
Incoming:\nGet up top. Now. That's an order.
Log:\nPicked up a wounded stalker by the road. Bandaged him, took him to the aid post. By morning he was gone. The medic says he walked out. With a bullet in his leg.
Incoming:\nTo group "Pennant". Escort the science team to the point. Do not report the task on the open net. Keep callsigns.
Incoming:\nEmission in twenty minutes. Where are you?
Outgoing:\nIn the open. We won't make the checkpoint.
Incoming:\nOld farm on your right, there's a cellar. Get in.
Outgoing:\nSomeone's already in the cellar.
Incoming:\nWhoever it is - they'll make room.
Log:\nFifth transfer request. Fifth "not permitted". But walking past the "merry-go-round" twice a day is permitted.
Log:\nA stalker at the checkpoint tried to bribe us with sausage. Sausage! Do we look like dogs? ...We took the sausage.
Incoming:\nAll posts. Mercenaries in our sector. Better armed and equipped than us. Avoid contact, report.
Incoming:\nWho let a group in camo with no insignia through?
Outgoing:\nThey had papers. Stamped.
Incoming:\nStamped by whom?
Outgoing:\nA real stamp, Comrade Major. I checked.
Incoming:\nThat's exactly what worries me.
